A free first adventure for D&D 5e

The First Lantern

The festival is about to begin, but the ember that lights the harbour lanterns is missing. Follow the soot trail and find out who needs the warmth more.

Get the adventure
60–90 minutes
Play in one session
3–4 players
Plus one Dungeon Master
Level 1
D&D 5e · 2024 rules

Get ready to play

For players

Pick a ready-to-play character. The player kit explains what to roll, what to do on your turn and how to read your sheet.

Download player kit (PDF)

For the Dungeon Master

The guide gives you read-aloud text, checks with clear outcomes, an optional first fight and a keyed map. Read this one before the session.

Download DM guide (PDF) Download player map (PNG)

At the table

Bring a set of dice and a pencil, or use a dice roller. One person describes the world. Everyone else decides what their character tries. The guide introduces each kind of roll as it comes up.

Read the free 2024 rules
